core: Golgi glycosylation donor supply and glycosphingolipid biosynthesis
qualifier: GDP-fucose synthesis and SLC35/SLC33A1 transporter defects
name: Golgi sugar-donor supply and glycosphingolipid biosynthesis
rationale: Members concern supplying Golgi glycosylation donors (CMP-sialic acid, UDP-Gal, UDP-GlcNAc, GDP-fucose, acetyl-CoA transporter defects; GDP-fucose synthesis) and glycosphingolipid/ganglioside synthesis, which the nucleotide-sugar transport, PAPS and N-glycan confusables lack.

name: FGFR4 downstream signaling and FGFR phospholipase C cascades
rationale: All members are FGFR downstream cascades, dominated by FGFR4 (FRS, SHC, PI3K, betaKlotho) plus PLC-gamma cascades, whereas confusables carry FGFR1-3 PI3K/FRS/SHC branches.

name: TCR signaling with CD28 costimulation and co-inhibition
rationale: Members cover proximal and downstream TCR signaling, IL-2 output and its tuning by CD28 costimulation and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition, which separates the theme from BCR and T cell differentiation confusables.

name: Regulation of vascular smooth muscle proliferation, migration, differentiation
rationale: Every member is positive or negative regulation of vascular smooth muscle cell proliferation, migration or differentiation, while confusables concern endothelial activation, phenotypic switching and vessel remodeling.

qualifier: direct reversal of DNA alkylation damage
name: Redox detoxification with direct reversal of alkylation damage
rationale: Members span ROS and aldehyde/methylglyoxal detoxification, NADPH regeneration and repair of damaged protein, with ALKBH/MGMT direct reversal of alkylated DNA distinguishing it from glutathione and ascorbate confusables.

name: Opsin-mediated visual phototransduction and light detection
rationale: Members are opsins, phototransduction activation/recovery, its disease variants and light detection, distinct from retinoid-cycle and photoreceptor-development confusables.

name: Lysosomal GAG degradation in Sanfilippo and Morquio mucopolysaccharidoses
rationale: Members are heparan, keratan and chondroitin/dermatan sulfate degradation and the MPS III and MPS IV disorders, whereas confusables carry Hurler, Hunter, Sly and Maroteaux-Lamy types.

core: Hematopoietic stem and progenitor cell regulation
name: Hematopoietic stem-progenitor maintenance and erythroid differentiation
rationale: Members cover HSC proliferation, division and homeostasis, RUNX1-driven HSC differentiation, myeloid progenitor programmes and erythrocyte differentiation, lacking the B cell and bone marrow niche terms of confusables.

qualifier: netrin and semaphorin-plexin signaling with axon extension
name: Netrin and semaphorin-plexin axon guidance and extension
rationale: All members concern guided axon growth via netrin and semaphorin-plexin signaling and positive axon extension, while confusables emphasise Sema3A chemorepulsion and negative extension control.

name: Lipoxygenase-derived pro-resolving lipid mediator biosynthesis
rationale: Members are biosynthesis of resolvins, protectins, maresins, lipoxins and their HETE precursors, distinguishing the theme from leukotriene, hepoxilin and eicosanoid-catabolism confusables.

qualifier: oxidation, elongation and ether lipid synthesis
name: Peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation, elongation and ether lipid synthesis
rationale: Members span peroxisomal alpha/beta/omega-oxidation, very-long-chain fatty acid synthesis, plasmalogen/wax synthesis and peroxisome maintenance, unlike the protein-import and bile-acid confusables.

name: Polyamine biosynthesis by ornithine decarboxylase and transport
rationale: Members cover ODC-regulated putrescine and spermidine synthesis and polyamine transport, whereas confusables concern polyamine oxidation/interconversion, methionine salvage or urea-cycle amino acids.

qualifier: with mast cell and granulocyte differentiation
name: Eosinophil and mast cell differentiation, migration and activation
rationale: Members concern eosinophil differentiation, chemotaxis, activation and immunity plus mast cell and granulocyte differentiation, lacking the Th2 cytokine signaling of confusables.

qualifier: ARE-binding proteins and stress granule dynamics
name: Cytoplasmic mRNA decay, stabilization and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members cover ARE-binding protein control of mRNA stability, deadenylation, decapping, translational control and stress granule/P-body assembly, distinct from the miRNA/siRNA silencing confusables.

name: Amino sugar and mannose catabolism toward fructose 6-phosphate
rationale: Members are GlcNAc, glucosamine, sialic acid, chitin and mannose breakdown with hexose phosphorylation converging on fructose 6-phosphate, whereas confusables cover sialic acid and UDP-GlcNAc synthesis or lysosomal glycolipid catabolism.

name: Notch target gene transcription via NOTCH3 and NOTCH4
rationale: Members are Notch-driven transcription and its regulation, with NOTCH3/NOTCH4 ICD transcription distinguishing it from NOTCH1/NOTCH2-centred confusables.

name: Integrin-matrix focal adhesion signaling including MET-FAK coupling
rationale: Members cover integrin, syndecan and fibronectin matrix adhesion, focal adhesion and stress fiber assembly and cell spreading, with MET-PTK2/tensin signaling setting it apart from EMT and ROCK/PAK confusables.

name: Purinergic GPCR signaling and extracellular ATP turnover
rationale: Members are P2Y and adenosine P1 receptor signaling, ATP export and NTPDase hydrolysis, distinct from histamine, serotonin, acetylcholine and lipid GPCR confusables.

qualifier: G protein and beta-arrestin effector branches
name: Dopamine receptor G protein and beta-arrestin signaling
rationale: Members are dopamine receptors coupling to adenylate cyclase, PLC and beta-arrestin and their postsynaptic effects, whereas confusables concern drug-response behaviour, DARPP-32 and cAMP turnover.

qualifier: response to food and nutrient levels
name: Regulation of appetite and food response
rationale: All three members regulate appetite or the response to food and nutrient levels, while confusables concern eating behaviour, ghrelin or glucocorticoid stress output.

name: Cell death execution, nuclear dismantling and tissue involution
rationale: Members cover apoptotic DNA fragmentation, chromatin condensation, lamina breakdown, execution-phase control, autophagic death and developmental/involution death, unlike dependence-receptor, necroptosis, PAK-2 and BAF confusables.

qualifier: anion exchange, proton transport and organelle acidification
name: Anion exchange and proton transport in pH regulation
rationale: Members are bicarbonate/SLC26 anion exchangers, Na+/H+ exchangers, carbonic anhydrase and V-ATPase-driven organelle lumen acidification, distinct from P-type ATPase, phosphate and chloride cotransporter confusables.

core: Negative regulation of cell-matrix adhesion and migration
name: Negative regulation of angiogenic sprouting and cell-matrix adhesion
rationale: Members inhibit VEGF-driven endothelial sprouting, chemotaxis and proliferation together with integrin, Rho/Rac, lamellipodium and focal adhesion signaling, a combination no confusable holds.

core: Autophagosome and endosome fusion with lysosomes
name: Autophagosome maturation and endosome-lysosome fusion trafficking
rationale: Members cover autophagosome assembly/maturation regulation and fusion of autophagosomes, phagosomes, MVBs and endosomes with lysosomes, rather than the selective autophagy types of confusables.

name: Phenylalanine and tyrosine catabolism with tetrahydrobiopterin cofactor
rationale: Members are phenylalanine/tyrosine degradation, phenylketonuria, BH4 synthesis and general organic/amino acid metabolism terms, distinct from glycine, threonine, proline and sulfur amino acid confusables.
